scope: Prospectively defined anonymous A/B Source-warrant comparison of two full assessments on one exposed case
criteria_origin: Unchanged original frozen full-assessment private scientific criteria; no expected clinical judgment
reviewer_input: Anonymous signaling answers/justifications/unknowns and exact citation bodies/coordinates, common approved Result and complete frozen Source text and original guidance. No model labels, telemetry, tool counts, raw traces, prior independent-review findings, algorithmic judgments or arm mapping.

score_scale.0: Unsupported or contradicted; wrong Source binding, substituted scope, or a material premise without a warrant
score_scale.1: Some relevant support but material ambiguity, incomplete inference or uncertainty inadequately bounded
score_scale.2: Defensible Source-grounded warrant with appropriate limitations; minor unresolved gaps
score_scale.3: Clear scoped Source warrant and appropriate handling of relevant uncertainty and counterevidence

score_units: Each active signaling answer; separately Domain-level citation fidelity, Result scope, inference/materiality, chronology/plan correspondence and uncertainty/counterevidence. Nonapplicable dimensions explicitly NA, never zero.
requirements: Review each arm independently before comparing
Cite physical Source page/lines for each material finding and score
Separate a Source saying a method was planned from evidence it was performed
Do not infer complete observations from ITT inclusion
Preserve source conflicts and timing/version uncertainty; no expected clinical label
Distinguish structural identity/algorithmic checks from scientific entailment
Mark absent inspected evidence rather than guess from trial familiarity
Return scores and warrants as locked artifact before model labels/telemetry/mapping are revealed
mapping_policy: Random A/B assignment generated privately after raw outputs are sealed; mapping not in reviewer packet. No reveal until reviewer score artifact hashed/locked.
history_policy: Final committed answer sets are the primary comparison; revision/citation history and observed actual delivery are analyzed separately after score lock, without giving prior AI audit opinions to reviewer.
paid_limits: Exactly one authorized Sol full-assessment session. Independent-review packet preparation does not authorize another benchmark session. Paid benchmark work stops after that outcome.
